state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is in progress. Install, the Tour, Why people pick Novis, Simple programs and Cookbook are done, and `--check guides` is written.**

Install has four pages under `install/`, snippets under `website/snippets/install/`. Novis has no release yet, so the install page builds from source.

The Tour is `guides/tour/index.mdx` and ten steps. Novis has no free functions (`E0215`), so every snippet uses a class. A compile error or `nvs test` output is shown as a `txt` block copied from a real run.

Why people pick Novis is `guides/why-novis/index.mdx` and 11 candidate pages. The user curates the final list when the goal lands.

Simple programs (six pages) and Cookbook (`guides/cookbook/index.mdx` and ten task pages) give each program its own folder under `website/snippets/guides/<section>/<name>/`, because an `nvs.toml` there configures every snippet in the folder. The page shows that `nvs.toml` as a `toml` block. A request program has a `.nvsr`. An HTTP call uses `Core\Test::answerHttp`, so it runs without a network. A database snippet uses `Core\Db::connect` with a `[db.<name>]` block and `[capabilities.db] connect`; `Core\Db::open` needs a grant the site runner does not give.

`--check guides` (`guidesProblems` in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts`) fails now only on `how-to-use`, `testing`, `production` and `example-apps`. `site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax` and `--build` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stage 6 rewrites. `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs (`LATER` in `site.ts`).

A page whose `covers:` names a feature id needs `bun nv site --stamp <page>` before `--check stale` passes.

In the sidebar, How to use goes between Simple programs and Cookbook, and Testing and Production after Cookbook, in `GUIDE_SECTIONS` order.
